Resolutions of 1977

20 resolutions, 65% unanimous. Late Cold War.

  • 403 (1977) Southern Rhodesia's acts of provocation against Botswana
  • 404 (1977) The UN special mission to Benin
  • 405 (1977) Condemning the armed aggression against Benin of 16 January 1977
  • 406 (1977) Assistance to Botswana
  • 407 (1977) Assistance to Lesotho
  • 408 (1977) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Disengagement Observer Force
  • 409 (1977) Prohibition of the use or transfer of any funds in their territories by Southern Rhodesia
  • 410 (1977) Extension of the stationing in Cyprus of the UN Peace-keeping Force
  • 411 (1977) Southern Rhodesia's military activities against Mozambique
  • 412 (1977) Admission of Djibouti to membership in the United Nations
  • 413 (1977) Admission of Viet Nam to membership in the United Nations
  • 414 (1977) Calling for a resumption of negotiations on the Cyprus question
  • 415 (1977) Appointment of a representative of the Secretary-General on Southern Rhodesia
  • 416 (1977) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Emergency Force
  • 417 (1977) Condemning the South African Government for its resort to massive violence and repression against the black people
  • 418 (1977) Establishment of an arms embargo against South Africa
  • 419 (1977) Assistance to Benin to repair the damage caused by the aggression of 16 January 1977
  • 420 (1977) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Disengagement Observer Force
  • 421 (1977) Establishment of a Security Council Committee concerning the question of South Africa
  • 422 (1977) Extension of the stationing in Cyprus of the UN Peace-keeping Force
